name: Distinguish necessary from sufficient conditions
short_description: Distinguish necessary from sufficient conditions once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can distinguish necessary from sufficient conditions in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Distinguish necessary from sufficient conditions means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Distinguish necessary from sufficient conditions in a fresh real-life scenario.
